additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438696-DC/Si-D/NZ- [MP / P3 170000347] AC connector is out of order CRM:02832000241
additional_info.body:
Hey Francisco,
There is currently a blocker out to not proceed with any firmware updates in the region of Australia and New Zealand, as updating from version 6.0.3, shows the charger as offline on SCB (except for logs).
Would you please be able to provide us more information about this hotfix you wanted to apply and how it applies to the AC charging socket?
From SCB logs, we seeing the following;
PLC-Error-Flag 'Outlet_AC1_codes' initial value true - (AC1 Errorcode:13)
PLC-Error-Flag 'Meter_BC5_AC_Charging' initial value true - (meter AC charging)
PLC-Error-Flag 'RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging' initial value true - (RCD or/and MCB AC charging)
With the customer reporting the AC charging socket is not releasing the cable.
Hey Liz,
The charger does appear to have similar communication issues as we had seen with other chargers updated from 6.0.3.
We are however able to see error logs coming through and the customer is charging on the DC outlets, however noting that there are still error logs relating to the AC socket, as in the initial technical support request.
To further assess the AC charging socket issue, it would require on site assessment.
Would you prefer if the quote for on-site work comes direct from us? This would include Sean and expert services time to assist on the fault?
Or would you prefer to get a quote from Sean separately to us?
Error code 13 means G_AC_OUTLET_STAT_CODE_FUSE_OR_RCD_TRIPPED.
So we would need to inspect FC5 and FB1 and see if they are tripped and validate that there is not persistent fault if after resetting it, it still trips.
We also need to check the feedbackline for FB1 and ensure there are no loss connection and signals are correctly arriving at the PLC.
Another global case shows that FB1 ended up being replaced as it had repeated tripping even after multiple site visits to reset and investigate.
The part number for FB1 is 5SV3344-4. It has not been included in the quotation as you may have local stock.
If you also wish to have this component added to the quote, please let us know.
Attached you will find an estimation of the work for the AC charging port investigation along with the schedule of the rates and SIL.
If you do wish to do ahead with the on-site work, you can return the schedule of rates documented signed and we will begin scheduling in the works.
The above estimation would focus on the AC charging port, with the firmware downgrade of the CFast completed separately.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd. Australia
Customer Services
Application Service Engineer
Phone: +61 499 701 794
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
